rule: every blob of the FCDDH01R child subtree at the semantic-closure commit, plus every final-delivery artifact whose content does not depend on the not-yet-created final commit.

excluded.SHA256SUMS: excluded: it is the file being produced
excluded.final local bundle: excluded: created after the final commit and lives outside the tree
excluded.final tip and child-subtree identities: excluded: they depend on the final commit
excluded.any certificate depending on the final c: excluded: none exists; bundle identity and post-commit verification are reported out of band
